# Harborshine Cleaning Co.

> Harborshine Cleaning Co. provides professional residential, move-out, and deep cleaning services across San Diego, California.

## Navigation Sections
- [About Us](https://harborshineapp.netlify.app/#about): Company background and values.
- [Cleaning Services](https://harborshineapp.netlify.app/#services): Overview of standard, deep, and custom cleaning plans.
- [Before & After](https://harborshineapp.netlify.app/#move-out): Visual transformation comparisons of completed cleanings.
- [Reviews](https://harborshineapp.netlify.app/#reviews): Customer testimonials and 5-star feedback.
- [Coverage Areas](https://harborshineapp.netlify.app/#coverage-areas): Service locations across San Diego including Old Town, La Jolla, and Pacific Beach.
- [Contact Us](https://harborshineapp.netlify.app/#contact): Direct booking channels and customer support.
